_meta.calendar_summary: Duggan Bachelor Party — Panama City Jul 16–19
_meta.calendar_description: Bachelor party itinerary for Laurence Duggan. JW Marriott Panama, Jul 16–19, 2026. Subscribe to get all locked events + opt-in menu options on your calendar. Questions: contact George Mensing or Laurence Duggan.

hotel.name: JW Marriott Panama
hotel.address: Calle Isaac Hannono Missri, Punta Pacifica, Panama City, Panama
hotel.reservation_note: Rooms booked + paid by George Mensing. You will receive an individual confirmation email from JW Marriott; bring a photo ID to the front desk. Breakfast included.

_meta.dress_code_note: Some bars/clubs/restaurants require pants + nice shoes for nights.
_meta.weather_note: Hot. Brief afternoon rain typical in July.
_meta.transport_note: Uber works throughout the city. A party-bus option may be coordinated by George (status TBD).

events.summary: Arrival window — fly into PTY (Tocumen Intl)
events.description:
Most of you land Thursday afternoon. Aim to be at the JW by **~6 PM** for the 7 PM group dinner.

- **From PTY → JW**: Uber, ~30–45 min depending on traffic
- **Cost**: ~$30–40 USD
- Drop your flight info on the form below so we can carpool
events.location: Tocumen International Airport (PTY), Panama City

events.description:
Home base for all four nights — JW Marriott Panama in Punta Pacifica.

- **Address**: Calle Isaac Hannono Missri, Punta Pacifica, Panama City
- **Map**: [JW Marriott Panama ↗](https://maps.app.goo.gl/?q=JW+Marriott+Panama+Punta+Pacifica)
- **Check-in**: 3:00 PM Thu · **Check-out**: 11:00 AM Sun
- Rooms booked + paid by George. You'll get a confirmation email from JW directly — bring a photo ID to the front desk
- **Breakfast included** daily at MASI (lobby level)
events.location: JW Marriott Panama, Calle Isaac Hannono Missri, Punta Pacifica, Panama City, Panama

events.description:
Standard 3 PM check-in. Roll up to the front desk with your photo ID.

- Rooms are booked + paid by George
- Confirmation email comes from JW Marriott directly
- **Breakfast included** at MASI (lobby) every morning
events.location: JW Marriott Panama, Calle Isaac Hannono Missri, Punta Pacifica, Panama City, Panama

events.summary: Depart JW → Aya La Vida (Casco Viejo)
events.description:
Group muster in the JW lobby. Carpool Ubers to Casco Viejo for the 7 PM reservation.

- **Leave lobby**: 6:30 PM sharp
- **Ride**: ~15–20 min from JW
- Coordinate carpools in the group chat
events.location: JW Marriott Panama lobby — pickup point

events.description:
Night-one dinner — Panamanian cuisine in Casco Viejo, live music + dancing on Thursdays. Famous for tableside theatrics (steak tartare, rum flambé).

- **Dress**: smart casual
- **Avg price**: ~$30–60/person
- **Web**: [restaurantpanama.com](https://restaurantpanama.com/)
events.location: Aya La Vida, Casco Viejo, Panama City

events.description:
Walk over from Aya La Vida (~5–10 min) for locally-distilled rum cocktails. Pre-game for the cigar bar.

- **Vibe**: lively Casco Viejo rum bar
- **Web**: [pedromandinga.com](https://pedromandinga.com/)
events.location: Pedro Mandinga, Casco Viejo, Panama City

events.summary: Cigar bar — Valentino Siesto Club House
events.description:
Cigar lounge to close night one — walking distance from Pedro Mandinga.

- **What**: smoke + whiskey/scotch
- **IG**: [@valentinosiestoclubhouse](https://www.instagram.com/valentinosiestoclubhouse/)
- Uber back to JW when done
events.location: Valentino Siesto Club House, Casco Viejo, Panama City

events.description:
Roll out for the catamaran. Most charters launch from the Amador Causeway marinas (Flamenco / La Playita).

- **Ride**: ~15 min from JW
- **Eat first**: MASI breakfast at the hotel (opens early, included)
- **Bring**: swimsuit, sunscreen, hat, dry bag for your phone
- Confirm exact pier with George before we leave
events.location: JW Marriott Panama lobby — pickup point

events.description:
The signature day — private catamaran for the group, all the way out to Taboga and back.

- **Hours**: 9:00 AM – 3:00 PM (return is flexible — it's our boat)
- **On board**: Panamanian BBQ + open bar both ways
- **Beach time** at Taboga
- **Reference**: [sample itinerary](https://tinyurl.com/p5z7ytcb) · final boat + operator confirmed by George
- **Bring**: sunscreen, hat, swimsuit, dry bag
events.location: Panama Bay — Taboga Island

events.description: Return to the marina + Uber back to JW. Decompress and shower before Friday dinner.
events.location: Amador Causeway marina → JW Marriott Panama

events.summary: [OPT-IN A] Friday dinner — La Barbara x Aki (Casco Viejo)
events.description:
Sushi + craft cocktails in a hidden Casco Viejo speakeasy-style lounge. Light food after the catamaran BBQ.

- **Cap**: ~6–8 spots, **reservation required** (do not walk up)
- **Dress**: smart casual
- **Book**: [OpenTable ↗](https://www.opentable.com/r/la-barbara-panama-city)
- Walks straight into the Friday rooftop bar crawl after
events.location: La Barbara x Aki, Calle 10 & Av B, Casco Viejo, Panama City

events.summary: [OPT-IN B] Friday dinner — Mercado de Marisco (Fish Market)
events.description:
Iconic Panama fish market on the Cinta Costera — pick your seafood at the stalls, they grill it. Ceviche stalls outside. High-energy, casual, quintessential Panama.

- **Cap**: none, **walk-in**
- **Vibe**: casual, get-your-hands-dirty
- **Reference**: [TripAdvisor ↗](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Attraction_Review-g294480-d2589867-Reviews-Mercado_Publico_del_Marisco-Panama_City_Panama_Province.html)
- Easy ~10 min walk into Casco Viejo for the rooftop crawl
events.location: Mercado de Marisco, Cinta Costera, Panama City

events.summary: [OPT-IN C] Friday dinner — Tacos Cholula (Punta Pacifica, near JW)
events.description:
Casual tacos within walking distance of the JW. The no-Uber, low-effort move for anyone wrecked by the sun.

- **Cap**: none, **walk-in**
- **Distance**: walking from JW
- Catch up with the group at the rooftop crawl later via Uber
events.location: Tacos Cholula, Punta Pacifica, Panama City

events.summary: Depart for Casco Viejo → rooftop bar crawl
events.description:
Group muster at **Tantalo Rooftop** (Calle 8 & Av B, Casco Viejo).

- Uber from JW or post-dinner location
- Drinks start at 9:30 PM
events.location: Tantalo Rooftop, Casco Viejo, Panama City

events.description:
The signature Friday night — hop between Casco Viejo rooftops with city + ocean views.

- **Pacing**: ~3–4 rooftops over 3 hours
- **Dress**: pants + nice shoes
- **Reference**: [Casco Viejo rooftop guide ↗](https://cascoviejo360.com/rooftop-bars-at-night-a-casco-viejo-state-of-mind/)
events.location: Casco Viejo, Panama City

events.description:
Late-night add-on for whoever's still rolling.

- **Primary**: Le Palace (Bellavista) — ~15 min Uber from Casco Viejo
- **Alternates**: Teatro Amador (Casco Viejo, themed shows, two floors), La Gruta Azul (high-energy)
- **Heads up**: Saturday daytime starts early — pace yourself
events.location: Le Palace, Bellavista, Panama City

events.description:
**Track A only.** Uber from JW to the Miraflores Visitor Center.

- **Ride**: ~30 min
- **Tickets**: buy online in advance — [visitcanaldepanama.com ↗](https://visitcanaldepanama.com/en/points-of-interest/miraflores-visitor-center/)
events.location: JW Marriott Panama lobby — pickup point

events.summary: [TRACK A] Panama Canal — Miraflores Locks tour
events.description:
**Track A** — Panama Canal at eye-level. Watch ships transit the locks; museum + observation deck.

- **Tickets**: [visitcanaldepanama.com ↗](https://visitcanaldepanama.com/en/points-of-interest/miraflores-visitor-center/)
- **Reconvene**: all tracks meet at the **Mercado de Marisco** at **1:00 PM** for group lunch
events.location: Miraflores Visitor Center, Panama Canal

events.summary: [TRACK B] Depart JW → Tactical shooting range
events.description:
**Track B only.** Uber from JW to the range.

- **Range**: Top Gun Panamá — [topgunpanama.com ↗](https://topgunpanama.com)
- **Bring**: valid photo ID
- Allow Uber + check-in time
events.location: JW Marriott Panama lobby — pickup point

events.description:
**Track B** — tactical shooting at Top Gun Panamá. Bachelor-party-friendly tourist experience with multi-weapon packages.

- **Weapons**: 9mm pistol, AR15, 12ga shotgun, revolver
- **ID**: bring valid photo ID — tourists do **not** need a Panama firearms permit for supervised range experiences
- **Web**: [topgunpanama.com ↗](https://topgunpanama.com)
- **Reconvene**: all tracks meet at the **Mercado de Marisco** at **1:00 PM** for group lunch
events.location: Top Gun Panamá, Panama City

events.summary: [ALL TRACKS] Lunch — Mercado de Marisco (Fish Market)
events.description:
Combined lunch for **all three Saturday tracks** — A (Locks), B (Shooting), C (Golf) all land here at 1 PM.

- **Format**: pick your seafood at the stalls, they grill it. Casual, **no reservation needed**
- **Distance**: ~10 min from Casco Viejo, ~15 min from JW
- **Reference**: [TripAdvisor ↗](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Attraction_Review-g294480-d2589867-Reviews-Mercado_Publico_del_Marisco-Panama_City_Panama_Province.html)
events.location: Mercado de Marisco, Cinta Costera, Panama City

events.description:
**Track C only.** Early Uber to beat the heat + Panama afternoon rain.

- **Course**: Santa María Golf Club (Costa del Este)
- **Ride**: ~15 min from JW
- **Leave lobby**: 7:00 AM sharp
events.location: JW Marriott Panama lobby — pickup point

events.summary: [TRACK C] Golf — Santa María Golf Club (Jack Nicklaus)
events.description:
**Track C** — 18 holes at Santa María Golf Club. Jack Nicklaus design, Troon-managed.

- **Course**: par-72, 7,153 yds from the back tees
- **Sat green fee**: ~$175 + tax
- **Equipment rental**: ~$50 + tax
- **Pace target**: 4.5 hrs to wrap by 12:30
- **Reconvene**: all tracks meet at the **Mercado de Marisco** at **1:00 PM** — Uber straight from the course
events.location: Santa María Golf Club, Costa del Este, Panama City

events.summary: Hotel decompress — pool / shower / nap before Gaucho's
events.description:
Free time at the JW after the group fish-market lunch. Reset before Gaucho's.

- Pool deck (Azul Restaurant has the poolside bar)
- Shower, change into dinner clothes — **pants + nice shoes** for Gaucho's
- Don't be late for 7 PM
events.location: JW Marriott Panama, Punta Pacifica

events.description:
Gaucho's is on Calle Uruguay, ~10 min from JW. Coordinate Uber carpools.

- **Dress**: pants + nice shoes (enforced at the door)
events.location: JW Marriott Panama lobby — pickup point

events.description:
**Reservation for 11 — do not miss.** World-famous Argentine parrilla on Calle Uruguay.

- **Standout cuts**: bife de chorizo, 16oz filete en trozo
- **Dress**: pants + nice shoes (enforced)
- **IG**: [@gauchossteakhousepty](https://www.instagram.com/gauchossteakhousepty/)
events.location: Gaucho's Steakhouse, Calle Uruguay, Panama City

events.description:
Closing night — burlesque / gentlemen's club for whoever's in.

- **Venue**: TBD, picked at dinner based on the group's pulse
- George + LD will call it
events.location: Panama City

events.description:
Cap the night at a casino — Casco Viejo or near the hotel, picked day-of.

- **Bring**: photo ID
- Be honest with yourself about your tolerance — Sunday departures will hurt
events.location: Panama City

events.description:
Final hangs at MASI (JW breakfast — included). Send-off + photos before flights.

- **Format**: floating drop-in — pop down whenever you're up
- Some attendees stay through Mon Jul 20 (George stays Monday)
events.location: MASI Restaurant, JW Marriott Panama (lobby level)

events.description:
Standard 11:00 AM checkout.

- Drop bags at concierge if your flight is later
- Settle any incidentals at the front desk
events.location: JW Marriott Panama, Calle Isaac Hannono Missri, Punta Pacifica, Panama City, Panama
